CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 30
   C. 20
   D. 75

2. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

3. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

4. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 29
   C. 23
   D. 23.6

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 16
   C. 55
   D. 32

7. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

8. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 33
   C. 27
   D. 27.6

9. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

10. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 6
   C. 5
   D. 12.5

11. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

12. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 43

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
